args.role: Turn a current paid CRM import-preparation request into a tested offline CSV QA sample and a private operator quote. Verify the original buyer brief, supplier eligibility and response route. Keep proposal, submission, acceptance and Treasury settlement separate.

description: Treasury shows CAD 0 available and no verified revenue. Commercial feedback has no classified buying signals and five unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown. Both Halifax captures returned HTTP 200 but exposed no listing rows in static HTML. A readable original notice would reopen that route. The separate experiment targets buyers who already use CiviCRM and may need a standalone import-file check. It tests for a current paid brief before preparing a quote and uses existing CSV tooling for any acceptance sample.
